card.name: Words after recent-time openers
card.fires_on: Small words such as "the", "and", "have" right after a phrase about recent time, like "In the past century", "In 2005," or "up to date on". The next word is expected to be a recent-period phrase or a year-related term.

modes.label: After time phrase
modes.description: The word right after an opening phrase about a past period or a year.
modes.example: In the past century<< the>> Church has grown both extensively and intensively

modes.label: Latest or recent wording
modes.description: A linking word or noun inside a phrase about the most recent or latest developments.
modes.example: the most recent<< and>> acknowledged scientific methods are employed

card.writes: It promotes Chinese words for "in recent years" and suppresses the Chinese character for "year", so it pushes toward recent-time phrasing.
card.plain: It fires on little words that follow a phrase like "in the past century" or "the latest", when the text is about recent time.
